name: gas_pipe_insulated_pressure_drop
title: Gas pipe pressure drop and heat gain with insulation and fittings (R717)
summary: Insulated R717 gas line of the Laborelec 2002 toolkit: heat gain from ambient air (internal Nusselt correlation, insulation cylinder, external convection, dew point), Colebrook-White friction drop, fitting K-factor drops from a nearest-diameter table and an equivalent nozzle area identified from the total pressure drop.

authors: Felipe Trebilcock (ULiege Thermodynamics Lab, Dec 2002, for Laborelec)
origin.course: Laborelec refrigeration-line sizing toolkit (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory)

verification.reference: Solution stored in the EES file (52 variables; the runnable variant was verified against it, reference values converted kPa/kJ to Pa/J by hand)
verification.notes: 48 common variables, 44 within 6.2e-4. h_i/SP[2] 7.97e-2: EES-vs-CoolProp R717 enthalpy reference offset (differences unaffected); Pr 4.43e-2 and cp: stale procedure-local records of an older EES run; DELTAT_total 1.82e-3 (cp backend). Excluded: DELTAp_elbows/DELTAp_Tees (stale, inconsistent with the stored DpF), SP[6] (dead).

related_external: thermo_models TM-0309 (modeles/LABORELEC_2002/4_Pressure Drop/4_1_Liquid Pipes/Liquid Pipe/Liquid_Pipe_Pressure_Drop.EES, liquid-line variant, same procedures, not imported)
